CTA: Browse the full catalog -> https://www.northbaysupply.com/catalog

We're not going to fill your inbox with a sale you didn't ask for today.

We've been heads-down reviewing gear for the months ahead, and we'll be sharing specific picks, honest tradeoffs, and real-world weights and ratings as we go. Nothing oversold. Nothing that won't hold up when you actually need it.

If there's a trip type, terrain, or piece of kit you've been curious about, hit reply. We read every one, and your questions genuinely shape what we write about next.

More coming soon. Until then, get outside if you can.

— The Northbay Supply Team
